items.author: Ankur Saxena, Senior AI Analytics Engineer at Kaufland e-commerce, Nov 20
items.summary: Explains how Tableau Data Apps actually work: Claude builds the app through Tableau MCP, but once published it is plain web code with no LLM at runtime, and Tableau still enforces the viewer's permissions and row-level security. He flags a design risk: similar prompts produce look-alike apps. Counts not shown.

items.author: 황예환 (Yehwan Hwang), BI Consultant, Tableau Ambassador, Nov 19
items.summary: Built the same Data App twice, once with a design.md style guide (number format, color, type, titles). The styled app opened with a conclusion sentence and company formatting, but one chart title still disagreed with the time grain, so he separates reusable style rules from per-screen decisions. [Write-up](https://kr.vizney.com/tableau-data-apps-design-md/). 1 reaction, 1 comment.

items.author: Fiona Crocker, Data & Analytics Leader, 9x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 19
items.summary: Built an HR leave data app in Tableau Studio in under 30 minutes from fake HR data (trends, year-on-year comparisons, a watch list), and asks how teams will keep quality up as building gets faster. 19 reactions, 4 comments, 2 reposts.

items.author: Yoshihito Kimura, Tableau Zen Master, Nov 20
items.summary: Gave Claude a data source and had it build a MakeoverMonday-style Data App on when and where UFO sightings happen, with a US map and time-of-day charts. 10 reactions.
